corrections_to_original_evidence.import_check_coverage: The original claim of tracking all 64 compose services covered only the 9 services whose Dockerfile matched a stage-0 matrix build target; the matrix compose_services mirror is removed and scripts/ci_stage0.py now derives every service from docker compose config.
corrections_to_original_evidence.lock_check_coverage: The original check inspected only services/loop-control by substring match and skipped any shared package that ships its own Dockerfile; it now parses imports with ast (import statements and literal importlib.import_module/__import__ calls) over every services/*/requirements.txt module and reports 20 pre-existing gaps, recorded as KNOWN_GAPS in scripts/check_service_lock_shared_deps.py.
corrections_to_original_evidence.datasources_test: The original test exec'd a copy of the fallback source; it now re-imports the real module with the policy modules unavailable and was verified to fail when the permissive fallback is restored.
corrections_to_original_evidence.telemetry_ingest_missing_schema: Before this task TelemetryIngestService._validate_event returned valid when the configured schema file was missing; it now rejects every event when a schema_path is configured but the schema did not load (test: TestMissingSchemaFileFailsClosed). With no schema_path configured it stays pass-through, as in unit fixtures.

validators_left_as_is.reason: Safe to leave: it only builds draft signal_snapshot registry entries after the artifact_type, draft state, sha256 checksum and lineage checks above it have already passed, and registry admission re-validates the schema. Its image is hash-locked (dependencies/locks/services-research-statsmodels.txt) without jsonschema, is not a compose service, and a lock recompile needs uv with network access.

image_import_smoke.how: python3 scripts/ci_stage0.py import-smoke --image-id <id>: docker build, then docker run --entrypoint python with the compose environment (and the compose postgres service for images that open stores at import) importing the effective ENTRYPOINT+CMD or compose command; uvicorn app attributes are checked, scripts run under runpy with a non-__main__ name so dataclasses resolve, shell commands get bash -n.
image_import_smoke.triggers: pull_request to dev (images whose Dockerfile, named lock/requirements or Python source changed), schedule 17 3 * * *, and workflow_dispatch (all images)
image_import_smoke.pull_request_run: https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/actions/runs/37455671830 (38 selected images succeeded; Branch CI Gate success on the same head)

stage0_zero_job_runs.finding: The 99 earlier zero-job Stage 0 failures were pull_request runs on promote/* heads opened by github-actions[bot]; every other pull_request workflow on those heads (Regression Tests, Syntax Tests, Research Regression Tests, Build & Test Lean, BFF Route Diff, Canonical Review Gate) failed the same way, so the cause is the bot-opened PR event, not a line in stage-0-ci.yml (actionlint is clean and the run name resolves to the workflow title). The workflow had never run on a dev pull request; with the dev trigger it now schedules jobs (run 37455671830).
stage0_zero_job_runs.not_fixed: Promote PRs opened with GITHUB_TOKEN still do not get Stage 0 jobs; Branch CI Gate already covers them through an explicit workflow_dispatch.

residual_stage0_failures_not_in_scope: Verify changed services (persona, bff, cron, governance-api) fail because pytest is not installed for their unittest discovery, and Docker build dry run (research-base) fails; these targets had not run since the workflow stopped triggering and are outside this task.
